dn19:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate.
dn19:1.3: Atha kho Pañcasikho Gandhabba-putto abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkanta-vaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Gijjhakūṭaṃ obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi. Ekamantaṃ ṭhito kho Pañcasikho Gandhabbaputto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:

dn19:2.3: Puratthimāya disāya Dhataraṭṭho Mahārājā pacchābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā.
dn19:2.4: Dakkhiṇāya disāya Virūḷhako Mahārājā uttarābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā.
dn19:2.5: Pacchimāya disāya Virūpakkho Mahārājā puratthābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā.
dn19:2.6: Uttarāya disāya Vessavaṇo Mahārājā dakkhiṇābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā.
dn19:2.7: Yadā bhante kevalakappā ca devā Tāvatiṃsā Sudhammāyaṃ sabhāyaṃ sannisinnā honti sannipatitā, mahatī ca dibbā parisā samantato nisinnā honti, cattāro ca mahārājā catuddisā nisinnā honti, idaṃ tesaṃ hoti āsanasmiṃ,
dn19:3.1: Ye te bhante devā Bhagavati brahmacariyaṃ caritvā adhun-uppannā Tāvatiṃsa-kāyā, te aññe deve atirocanti vaṇṇena c' eva yasasā ca.
dn19:3.2: Tena sudaṃ bhante devā Tāvatiṃsā attamanā honti pamuditā pīti-somanassa-jātā:
dn19:3.3: "Dibbā vata bho kāyā paripūrenti, hāyanti asura-kāyā ti." 3.

dn19:3.21: Tena sudaṃ bhante devā Tāvatiṃsā bhīyoso mattāya attamanā honti pamuditā pīti-somanassa-jātā:

dn19:4.2: "Iccheyyātha no tumhe mārisā tassa Bhagavato aṭṭha yathā-bhucce vaṇṇe sotun ti?"
dn19:4.3: "Iccheyyāma mayaṃ mārisa tassa Bhagavato aṭṭha yathā-bhucce vaṇṇe sotun ti."
dn19:4.4: Atha bhante Sakko devānam indo devānaṃ Tāvaṭiṃsānaṃ Bhagavato aṭṭha yathā-bhucce vaṇṇe payirudāhāsi. 5.

dn19:13.1: Tatra kho bhante ekacce devā evam āhaṃsu:--
dn19:13.2: "Aho vata mārisā cattāro Sammā-sambuddhā loke uppajjeyyuṃ, dhammañ ca deseyyuṃ, yathariva Bhagavā.
dn19:13.3: Tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampakāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānan" ti.
dn19:13.5: "Tiṭṭhantu mārisā cattāro sammā-sambuddhā. Aho vata mārisā tayo sammā-sambuddhā loke uppajjeyyuṃ dhammañ ca deseyyuṃ, yathariva Bhagavā.
dn19:13.6: Tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampakāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānan" ti.
dn19:13.8: "Tiṭṭhantu mārisā tayo sammā-sambuddhā. Aho vata mārisā dve sammā-sambuddhā loke uppajjeyyuṃ, dhammañ ca deseyyuṃ, yathariva Bhagavā.
dn19:13.9: Tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampakāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānan" ti. 14.
dn19:14.1: Evaṃ vutte bhante Sakko devānam indo deve Tāvatiṃse etad avoca:--
dn19:14.2: "Aṭṭhānaṃ kho etaṃ mārisā anavakāso yaṃ ekissā loka-dhātuyā dve arahanto sammā-sambuddhā apubbaṃ acarimaṃ uppajjeyyuṃ. N' etaṃ ṭhānaṃ vijjati.
dn19:14.3: Aho vata mārisā so Bhagavā appābādho appātaṅko ciraṃ dīgham addhānaṃ tiṭṭheyya.
dn19:14.4: Tad assa bahujana-hitāya bahujana-sukhāya lokānukampakāya atthāya hitāya sukhāya deva-manussānan" ti.
dn19:14.5: Atha bhante yen' atthena devā Tāvatiṃsā Sudhammāya sabhāyaṃ sannisinnā honti sannipatitā, taṃ atthaṃ cintayitvā taṃ atthaṃ mantayitvā vutta-vacanā pi taṃ cattāro Mahārājā tasmiṃ atthe honti,
dn19:14.6: paccanusiṭṭha-vacanā pi taṃ cattāro Mahārājā tasmiṃ atthe honti sakesu āsanesu ṭhitā avippakantā.
dn19:15.1: Atha bhante uttarāya disāya uḷāro āloko sañjāyi obhāso pātur ahosi atikamm' eva devānaṃ devānubhāvaṃ.
dn19:15.2: Atha bhante Sakko devānam indo deve Tāvatiṃse āmantesi: 14
dn19:15.3: "Yathā kho mārisā nimittā dissanti āloko sañjāyati obhāso pātu bhavati Brahmā pātu bhavissati.
dn19:15.4: Brahmuno etaṃ pubba-nimittaṃ pātubhāvāya yadidaṃ āloko sañjāyati obhāso pātu bhavatīti.
dn19:16.1: Atha bhante devā Tāvatiṃsā yathā sakesu āsanesu nisīdiṃsu:
dn19:16.2: "Obhāsam etaṃ ñassāma, yaṃ-vipāko bhavissati, sacchikatvā va naṃ gamissāmāti."
dn19:16.3: Cattāro ca Mahārājā yathā sakesu āsanesu nisīdiṃsu:
dn19:16.4: "Obhāsam etaṃ ñassāma, yaṃ vipāko bhavissati, sacchikatvā va naṃ gamissāmāti."
dn19:16.5: Idaṃ sutvā devā Tāvatiṃsā ekaggatā samāpajjiṃsu:
dn19:16.6: "Obhāsam etaṃ ñassāma, yaṃ-vipāko bhavissati, sacchikatvā va naṃ gamissāmāti." 16.
dn19:16.7: Yadā bhante Brahmā Sanaṃkumāro devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ pātu bhavati, oḷārikaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinimminitvā pātu bhavati.
dn19:16.8: Yo kho pana bhante Brahmuno pakati-vaṇṇo anabhisambhavanīyo, so devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ cakkhu-pathasmiṃ.
dn19:16.9: Yadā bhante Brahmā Sanaṃkumāro devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ pātu bhavati, so aññe deve atirocati vaṇṇena c' eva yasasā ca.
dn19:16.10: Seyyathā pi bhante sovaṇṇo viggaho mānusaṃ viggahaṃ atirocati,
dn19:16.11: evam eva kho bhante yadā Brahmā Sanaṃkumāro devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ pātu bhavati, so aññe deve atirocativaṇṇena c' eva yasasā ca.
dn19:16.12: Yadā bhante Brahmā Sanaṃkumāro devānaṃ Tāvatiṃsānaṃ pātu bhavati, na tassa parisāyaṃ koci devo abhivādeti vā paccuṭṭheti vā āsanena nimanteti
dn19:16.13: vā. Sabbe tuṇhī-bhūtā pañjalikā pallaṅkena nisīdanti:
dn19:16.14: "Yassa dāni devassa icchissati Brahmā Sanaṃkumāro, tassa devassa pallaṅke nisīdissatīti."

dn19:17.2: evam eva kho bhante yassa devassa Brahmā Sanaṃkumāro pallaṅke nisīdati, uḷāraṃ so labhati devo veda-paṭilābhaṃ, uḷāraṃ so labhati devo somanassa-paṭilābhaṃ. 17.

dn19:28.8: Taṃ kiṃ maññanti bhonto devā Tāvatiṃsā? Yāva dīgha-rattaṃ mahā-pañño ca so Bhagavā ahosi.
dn19:29.1: Bhūta-pubbaṃ bho rājā Disampatī nāma ahosi.
dn19:29.2: Disampatissa rañño Govindo nāma brāhmaṇo purohito ahosi.
dn19:29.3: Disampatissa rañño Reṇu nāma kumāro putto ahosi.
dn19:29.4: Govindassa brāhmaṇassa Jotipālo nāma māṇavo putto ahosi.
dn19:29.5: Iti Reṇu ca rājaputto Jotipālo ca māṇavo aññe ca chakkhattiyā icc ete aṭṭha sahāyā ahesuṃ.
dn19:29.6: Attha kho ahorattānaṃ accayena Govindo brāhmaṇo kālam akāsi.

dn19:29.8: ‘Yasmiṃ vata bho mayaṃ samaye Govinde brāhmaṇe sabba-kiccāni sammavossajjitvā pañcahi kāma-guṇehi samappitā samaṅgi-bhūtā paricārema, tasmiṃ samaye Govindo brāhmaṇo kālakato' ti.
dn19:29.9: Evaṃ vutte bho Reṇu rājaputto rājānaṃ Disampatiṃ etad avoca:--
dn19:29.10: ‘Mā kho tvaṃ deva Govinde brāhmaṇe kālakate atibāḷhaṃ paridevesi.
dn19:29.11: Atthi deva Govindassa brāhmaṇassa Jotipālo nāma māṇavo putto paṇḍitataro c' eva pitarā alamatthadasataro c' eva pitarā.
dn19:29.12: Ye pi 'ssa pitā atthe anusāsi, te pi Jotipālass' eva māṇavassa anusāsaniyā' ti.
dn19:30.1: Atha kho bho rājā Disampati aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:--
dn19:30.2: ‘Ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa, yena Jotipālo māṇavo ten' upasaṃkama, upasaṃkamitvā Jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
dn19:30.3: Bhavam atthu bhavantaṃ Jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ, rājā Disampati bhavantaṃ Jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantayati. Rājā Disampati bhoto Jotipālassa māṇavassa dassana-kāmo' ti.
dn19:30.4: ‘Evaṃ devāti' bho so puriso Disampatissa rañño paṭissutvā yena Jotipālo māṇavo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Jotipāla-māṇavaṃ etad avoca:--
dn19:30.5: ‘Bhavam atthu bhavantaṃ Jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ. Rājā Disampati bhavantaṃ Jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ āmantayati. Rājā Disampati bhoto Jotipālassa māṇavassa dassana-kāmo' ti.
dn19:30.6: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho bho Jotipālo māṇavo tassa purisassa paṭissutvā yena rājā Disampati ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Disampatinā raññā saddhiṃ sammodi,
dn19:30.7: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho bho Jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ rājā Disampati etad avoca:--
dn19:30.8: ‘Anusāsatu no bhavaṃ Jotipālo māṇavo, mā bhavaṃ Jotipālo anusāsaniyā paccavyāhāsi.
dn19:30.9: Pettike taṃ ṭhāne ṭhapayissāmi, Govindiye abhisiñcissāmīti.'
dn19:30.10: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho bho Jotipālo māṇavo Disampatissa rañño paccassosi. 31.
dn19:31.1: Atha kho bho rājā Disampati Jotipālaṃ māṇavaṃ Govindiye abhisiñci, pettike ṭhāne ṭhapesi.
dn19:31.2: Abhisitto Jotipālo māṇavo Govindiye pettike ṭhāne ṭhapito ye pi 'ssa pitā atthe anusāsi, te atthe anusāsati; ye pi 'ssa pitā atthe nānusāsi, te pi atthe nānusāsati.
dn19:31.3: Ye pi 'ssa pitā kammante abhisambhosi, te pi kammante abhisambhoti; ye pi 'ssa pitā kammante nābhisambhosi te pi kammante nābhisambhoti.
dn19:31.5: ‘Govindo vata bho brāhmaṇo, mahā Govindo vata bho brāhmaṇo' ti.
dn19:31.6: Iminā kho etaṃ bho pariyāyena Jotipālassa māṇavassa Mahā-Govindo Mahā-Govindo tv eva samaññā udapādi. 32.
dn19:32.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo yena te chakkhattiyā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te chakkhattiye etad
dn19:32.2: avocā:-‘Disampati bho rājā jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addhagato vayo-anuppatto. Ko nu kho pana bho jānāti jīvitānaṃ?
dn19:32.3: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yaṃ Disampatimhi raññe kālakate, rāja-kattāro Reṇuṃ rāja-puttaṃ rajje abhisiñceyyuṃ.
dn19:32.4: Āyantu bho bhonto, yena Reṇu rāja-putto ten' upasaṃkamatha, upasaṃkamitvā Reṇuṃ rāja-puttaṃ evaṃ vadetha:
dn19:32.5: "Mayaṃ bhoto Reṇussa sahāyā piyā manāpā appaṭikkūlā, yaṃ-sukho bhavaṃ taṃ-sukhā mayaṃ, yaṃ-dukkho bhavaṃ, taṃ-dukkhā mayaṃ.
dn19:32.6: Disampati bho rājā jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addha-gato vayo-anuppatto. Ko nu kho pana bho jānāti jīvitānaṃ?
dn19:32.7: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yaṃ Disampatimhi raññe kālakate rāja-kattāro bhavantaṃ Reṇuṃ rajje abhisiñceyyuṃ.
dn19:32.8: Sace bhavaṃ Reṇu rajjaṃ labhetha, saṃvibhajetha no rajjenāti."' 33.
dn19:33.1: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho bho te chakkhattiyā MahāGovindassa Brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena Reṇu rāja-putto ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu , upasaṃkamitvā Reṇuṃ rāja-puttaṃ etad avocuṃ:--
dn19:33.2: ‘Mayaṃ bhoto Reṇussa sahāyā piyā manāpā appaṭikkūlā,
dn19:33.3: yaṃ-sukho bhavaṃ taṃ-sukhā mayaṃ, yaṃ-dukkho bhavaṃ taṃ-dukkhā mayaṃ.
dn19:33.4: Disampati kho bho rājā jiṇṇo vuddho mahallako addha-gato vayo-anuppatto. Ko nu kho bho pana jānāti jīvitānaṃ?
dn19:33.5: Ṭhānaṃ kho pan' etaṃ vijjati yaṃ Disampatimhi raññe kālakate rājakattāro bhavantaṃ Reṇuṃ rajje abhisiñceyyuṃ.
dn19:33.6: Sace bhavaṃ Reṇu rajjaṃ labhetha, saṃvibhajetha no rajjenāti.'
dn19:33.7: ‘Ko no kho bho añño mama vijite sukham edheyyātha aññatra bhavantehi?
dn19:33.8: Sacāhaṃ bho rajjaṃ labhissāmi, saṃvibhajissāmi vo rajjenāti.' 34.
dn19:34.1: Atha kho bho ahorattānaṃ accayena rājā Disampati kālam akāsi.
dn19:34.2: Disampatimhi raññe kālakate rājakattāro Reṇuṃ rāja-puttaṃ rajje abhisiñciṃsu.
dn19:34.3: Abhisitto Reṇu rajjena pañcahi kāma-guṇehi samappito samaṅgibhūto paricāreti.
dn19:34.4: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo yena te chakkhattiyā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te chakkhattiye etad avoca:--
dn19:34.6: abhisitto bhavaṃ Reṇu rajjena pañcahi kāma-guṇehi samappito samaṅgibhūto paricāreti.
dn19:34.7: Ko nu kho pana bho jānāti? Madanīyā kāmā.
dn19:34.8: Āyantu bhonto, yena Reṇu rājā ten' upasaṃkamatha, upasaṃkamitvā Reṇuṃ rājānaṃ evaṃ vadetha:
dn19:34.9: "Disampati kho bho rājā kālakato, abhisitto bhavaṃ Reṇu rajjena, sarati bhavan tam vacanan" ti?'
dn19:34.10: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho bho te chakkhattiyā MahāGovindasa Brāhmaṇassa paṭissutvā yena Reṇu rājā ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā Reṇuṃ rājānaṃ etad avocuṃ:--
dn19:34.11: ‘Disampati kho bho rājā kālakato, abhisitto bhavaṃ Reṇu rajjena, sarati bhavan taṃ vacanan' ti? ‘
dn19:34.13: Ko nu kho bho pahoti imaṃ mahā-paṭhaviṃ uttarena āyataṃ dakkhiṇena sakaṭamukhaṃ sattadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajitun' ti?
dn19:34.14: ‘Ko nu kho bho añño pahoti aññatra Mahā-Govindena brāhmaṇenāti?' 35.
dn19:35.1: Atha kho bho Reṇu rājā aññataraṃ purisaṃ āmantesi:--
dn19:35.2: ‘Ehi tvaṃ ambho purisa yena Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo ten' upasaṃkama , upasaṃkamitvā Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ evaṃ vadehi:
dn19:35.4: ‘Evaṃ devo' ti kho bho so puriso Reṇussa rañño paṭissutvā yena Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ etad avoca:
dn19:35.6: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo tassa purisassa paṭissutvā yena Reṇu rājā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Reṇunā raññā saddhiṃ sammodi,
dn19:35.7: sammodanīyaṃ kathaṃ sārāṇīyaṃ vītisāretvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ Reṇu rājā etad avoca:
dn19:35.8: ‘Etu bhavaṃ Govindo imaṃ mahā-paṭhaviṃ uttarena āyataṃ dakkhiṇena sakaṭamukhaṃ sattadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhajatūti.
dn19:35.9: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Reṇussa rañño paṭissutvā, imaṃ mahā-paṭhaviṃ uttarena āyataṃ dakkhiṇena sakaṭamukhaṃ sattadhā samaṃ suvibhattaṃ vibhaji,
dn19:36.2: Tatra sudaṃ majjhe Reṇussa rañño janapado hoti.
dn19:36.11: Atha kho bho te chakkhattiyā yathā sakena lābhena attamanā ahesuṃ paripuṇṇa-saṃkappā:
dn19:36.12: ‘Yaṃ vata no ahosi icchitaṃ yaṃ ākaṅkhitaṃ yaṃ adhippetaṃ yaṃ adhipatthitaṃ, taṃ no laddhan ti.
dn19:36.16: tadāsuṃ satta Bhāratā ti. Paṭhama-bhāṇavāraṃ niṭṭhitaṃ. 37.
dn19:37.1: Atha kho bho te chakkhattiyā yena Mahā-Govindo Brāhmaṇo ten' upasaṃkamiṃsu, upasaṃkamitvā MahāGovindaṃ Brāhmaṇaṃ etad avocuṃ:
dn19:37.2: ‘Yathā bhavaṃ Govindo Reṇussa rañño sahāyo piyo manāpo appaṭikkūlo,
dn19:37.3: evam eva bhavam Govindo amhākaṃ pi sahāyo piyo manāpo appaṭikkūlo. Anusāsatu no bhavaṃ Govindo,
dn19:37.4: mā no bhavaṃ Govindo anusāsaniyā paccavyāhāsīti.
dn19:37.5: ‘Evaṃ bho' ti kho bho Mahā-Govindo Brāhmaṇo tesaṃ channaṃ khattiyānaṃ paccassosi.
dn19:37.6: Atha kho bho MahāGovindo Brāhmaṇo satta ca rājāno khattiye muddhāvasitte rajje anusāsi, satta ca brāhmaṇa- mahāsāle satta ca nahātaka-satāni mante vācesi. 38.
dn19:38.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindassa Brāhmaṇassa aparena samayena evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggañchi:
dn19:38.2: ‘Sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmānaṃ passati, sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.'
dn19:38.3: Atha kho bho MahāGovindassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi:
dn19:38.5: Sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmānaṃ passati, sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:38.6: Na kho panāhaṃ Brahmānaṃ passāmi, na Brahmunā sākacchemi, na Brahmūnā sallapāmi, na Brahmunā mantemi.
dn19:38.7: Sutaṃ kho pana m' etaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānam:
dn19:38.8: Yo vassike cattāro māse patisallīyati, karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyati, so Brahmānaṃ passati Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:38.9: Yannūnāhaṃ vassike cattāro māse patisallīyeyyaṃ karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyeyyan' ti. 39.
dn19:39.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo Brāhmaṇo yena Reṇu rājā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Reṇuṃ rājānaṃ etad avoca:
dn19:39.2: ‘Mayhaṃ kho bho evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn19:39.3: Sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmānaṃ passati, sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:39.4: Na kho panāhaṃ bho Brahmānaṃ passāmi, na Brahmunā sākacchemi, na Brahmunā sallapāmi, na Brahmunā mantemi.
dn19:39.5: Sutaṃ kho pana m' etaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn19:39.6: Yo vassike cattāro māse patisallīyati karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyati, so Brahmānaṃ passati, Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:39.7: Icchām' ahaṃ bho vassike cattāro māse patisallīyituṃ, karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyituṃ.
dn19:39.8: N' amhi kenaci upasaṃkamitabbo aññatra ekena bhattābhihārenāti.'
dn19:40.1: Atha kho Mahā-Govindo Brāhmaṇo yena te chakkhattiyā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā te chakkhattiye etad avoca:
dn19:40.3: Sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmānaṃ passati, sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:40.4: Na kho panāhaṃ Brahmānaṃ passāmi, na Brahmunā sākacchemi, na Brahmunā sallapāmi, na Brahmunā mantemi.
dn19:40.5: Sutaṃ kho pana m' etaṃ Brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn19:40.6: Yo vassike cattāro māse patisallīyati, karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyati, so Brahmānaṃ passati Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:40.7: Icchām' ahaṃ bho vassike cattāro māse patisallīyituṃ, karuṇaṃ jhāyaṃ jhāyituṃ.
dn19:40.8: N' amhi kenaci upasaṃkamitabbo aññatra ekena bhattābhihārenāti.
dn19:41.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo Brāhmaṇo yena satta ca Brāhmaṇa-mahā-sālā satta ca nahātaka-satāni ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā satta ca Brāhmaṇa-mahāsāle satta ca nahātaka-satāni etad avoca:--
dn19:41.2: ‘Mayhaṃ kho bho evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato:
dn19:41.3: Sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmānaṃ passati, sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:41.4: Na kho panāhaṃ kho Brahmānaṃ passāmi, na Brahmunā sākacchemi, na Brahmunā sallapāmi, na Brahmunā mantemi.
dn19:41.5: Sutaṃ kho pana m' etaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn19:41.6: Yo vassike cattāro māse patisallīyati, karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyati, so Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:41.7: Tena hi bho yathā sute yathā pariyatte mante vitthārena sajjhāyaṃ karotha, aññam aññañ ca mante vācetha.
dn19:41.8: Icchām' ahaṃ bho vassike cattāro māse patisallīyituṃ karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyituṃ.
dn19:41.9: N' amhi kenaci upasaṃkamitabbo aññatra ekena bhattābhihārenāti.'
dn19:42.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo yena cattārīsā bhariyā sādisiyo ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā cattārīsā bhariyā sādisiyo etad avoca:
dn19:42.2: ‘Mayhaṃ kho bhoti evaṃ kalyāṇo kittisaddo abbhuggato :
dn19:42.3: Sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmānaṃ passati, sakkhī Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:42.4: Na kho panāhaṃ bhoti Brahmānaṃ passāmi, na Brahmunā sākacchemi, na Brāhmunā sallapāmi, na Brahmunā mantemi.
dn19:42.5: Sutaṃ kho pana m' etaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ:
dn19:42.6: Yo vassike cattāro māse paṭisallīyati karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyati, so Brahmānaṃ passati, Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:42.7: Icchām' ahaṃ bhoti vassike cattāro māse patisallīyituṃ karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyituṃ.
dn19:42.8: N' amhi kenaci upasaṃkamitabbo aññatra ekena bhattābhihārenāti.'
dn19:43.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo puratthimena nagarassa navaṃ santhāgāraṃ kārāpetvā vassike cattāro māse patisallīyi , karuṇaṃ jhānaṃ jhāyi,
dn19:43.2: nāssuda koci upasaṃkami aññatra ekena bhattābhihārena.
dn19:43.3: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindassa brāhmaṇassa catunnaṃ māsānaṃ accayena ahud eva ukkaṇṭhanā ahu paritassanā:
dn19:43.4: Sutaṃ kho pana m' etaṃ Brāhmaṇānaṃ vuddhānaṃ mahallakānaṃ ācariya-pācariyānaṃ bhāsamānānaṃ :
dn19:43.5: Yo vassike cattāro māse patisallīyati karuṇaṃ jhāyaṃ jhāyati, so Brahmānaṃ passati, Brahmunā sākaccheti sallapati mantetīti.
dn19:43.6: Na kho panāhaṃ Brahmānaṃ passāmi, na Brahmunā sākacchemi, na Brahmunā sallapāmi, na Brahmunā mantemīti. 44.
dn19:44.1: Atha kho bho Brahmā Sanaṃkumāro MahāGovindassa Brāhmaṇassa cetasā ceto- parivitakkam aññāya, seyyathā pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam eva Brahma-loke antarahito Mahā-Govindassa brāhmaṇassa pamukhe pātur ahosi.
dn19:44.2: Atha kho bho MahāGovindassa brāhmaṇassa ahud eva bhayaṃ ahu chambhitattaṃ ahu lomahaṃso yathā taṃ adiṭṭha-pubbaṃ rūpaṃ disvā.
dn19:44.3: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo bhīto saṃviggo loma-haṭṭha-jāto Brahmānaṃ Sanaṃkumāraṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:--
dn19:45.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi:
dn19:45.3: Kin nu kho ahaṃ Brahmānaṃ Sanaṃkumāraṃ puccheyyaṃ diṭṭha-dhammikaṃ vā atthaṃ samparāyikaṃ vā ti?'
dn19:45.4: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindassa brāhmaṇassa etad ahosi:
dn19:45.5: ‘Kusalo kho ahaṃ diṭṭha-dhammikānaṃ atthānaṃ. Aññe pi maṃ diṭṭha-dhammikaṃ atthaṃ pucchanti.
dn19:45.6: Yannūnāhaṃ Brahmānaṃ Sanaṃkumāraṃ samparāyikaṃ yeva atthaṃ puccheyyan' ti.
dn19:45.7: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo Brahmānaṃ Sanaṃkumāraṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsi:
dn19:46.2: Idh' ekacco appaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā bhogakkhandhaṃ pahāya appaṃ vā ñāti-parivaṭṭaṃ pahāya mahantaṃ vā ñati-parivaṭṭaṃ pahāya kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajati.
dn19:46.3: Iti hitvā mamattaṃ tāhaṃ bhoto ājānāmi.
dn19:46.5: Idh' ekacco vivittaṃ senāsanaṃ bhajati araññaṃ rukkha-mūlaṃ pabbataṃ kandaraṃ giri-guhaṃ susānaṃ vana-patthaṃ abbhokāsaṃ palāla-puñjaṃ.
dn19:46.6: Iti ekodibhūto ti p' ahaṃ bhoto ājānāmi.
dn19:46.8: Idh' ekacco karuṇā-sahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā viharati, tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ karuṇā-sahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā viharati.
dn19:46.9: Iti karuṇādhimutto ti p' ahaṃ bhoto ājānāmi.
dn19:46.10: ‘Āmagandhe va kho ahaṃ bhoto bhāsamānassa na ājānāmi.
dn19:46.18: Lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho
dn19:46.21: ‘Yathā kho ahaṃ bhoto āmagandhe bhāsamānassa ājānāmi, te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:46.22: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti.
dn19:47.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo yena Reṇu rājā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā Reṇu- rājānaṃ etad avoca:
dn19:47.2: ‘Aññaṃ dāni bhavaṃ purohitaṃ pariyesatu, yo bhoto rajjaṃ anusāsissati.
dn19:47.3: Icchām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
dn19:47.4: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:47.5: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti.
dn19:47.42: ‘Sace bhavaṃ Govindo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati, aham pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmi.
dn19:47.43: Atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti.' 48.
dn19:48.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo yena te chakkhattiyā ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā chakkhattiye etad avoca:
dn19:48.2: ‘Aññaṃ dāni bhavanto purohitaṃ pariyesantu, yo bhavantānaṃ rajje anusāsissati.
dn19:48.3: Icchām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
dn19:48.4: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:48.5: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti.
dn19:49.1: Atha kho bho chakkhattiyā ekamantaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ:
dn19:49.3: yan nūna mayaṃ Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhanena sikkheyyāmāti.'
dn19:49.4: Te Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam āhaṃsu:
dn19:49.5: ‘Saṃvijjati kho bho imesu sattasu rajjesu pahūtaṃ sāpateyyaṃ. Tato bhoto yāvatakena attho tāvatakaṃ āhareyyatan ti.
dn19:49.6: ‘Alaṃ bho! Mama p' idaṃ pahūtaṃ sāpateyyaṃ bhavantānaṃ yeva vāhasā,
dn19:49.7: tam ahaṃ yasaṃ pahāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmi.
dn19:49.8: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa, te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:49.9: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti. 49.
dn19:49.10: Atha kho bho te chakkhattiyā ekamantaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ:
dn19:49.12: Yan nūna mayaṃ Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ itthīhi sikkheyyāmāti?'
dn19:49.13: Te Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ upasaṃkamitvā evam āhaṃsu: ‘
dn19:49.14: Saṃvijjante ' kho bho imesu sattasu rajjesu pahūtā itthiyo. Tato bhoto yāvatikāhi attho, tāvatikā āniyyatan' ti.
dn19:49.15: ‘Alaṃ bho! mama p' imā cattārīsā bhariyā sādisiyo.
dn19:49.16: Tā p' ahaṃ sabbā pahāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmi.
dn19:49.17: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa, te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:49.18: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti. 50.
dn19:50.1: ‘Sace bhavaṃ Govindo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati, mayam pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti.'
dn19:51.1: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ Govindo satta vassāni āgametu,
dn19:51.2: sattannaṃ vassānaṃ accayena mayam pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti.'
dn19:51.3: ‘Aticiraṃ kho bho satta vassāni. Nāhaṃ sakkomi bhavante satta vassāni āgametuṃ.
dn19:51.4: Ko kho pana bho jānāti jīvitānaṃ.
dn19:51.5: Gamanīyo samparāyo, mantāya bodhabbaṃ , kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, n' atthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
dn19:51.6: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:51.7: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti. 52.
dn19:52.1: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ Govindo cha vassāni āgametu . . . pe . . .
dn19:52.6: ekaṃ vassaṃ āgametu. Eka-vassassa accayena mayam pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti? 53.
dn19:53.1: ‘Aticiraṃ kho bho ekaṃ vassaṃ. Nāhaṃ sakkomi bhavante ekaṃ vassaṃ āgametuṃ.
dn19:53.2: Ko kho pana bho jānāti jīvitānaṃ.
dn19:53.3: Gamanīyo samparāyo, mantāya bodhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, n' atthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
dn19:53.4: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:53.5: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti.
dn19:53.6: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ Govindo satta māsāni āgametu. Sattannaṃ māsānaṃ accayena mayam pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti.' 54.
dn19:54.1: ‘Aticiraṃ kho bho satta māsāni. Nāhaṃ sakkomi bhavante satta māsāni āgametuṃ.
dn19:54.2: Ko kho pana bho jānāti jīvitānaṃ?
dn19:54.3: Gamanīyo samparāyo, mantāya bodhabbaṃ, kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, n' atthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
dn19:54.4: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:54.5: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti.
dn19:54.6: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ Govindo cha māsāni āgametu . . . pe . . .
dn19:54.12: [pe] . . . addha-māsaṃ āgametu. Addha-māsassa accayena mayam pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti. 55.
dn19:55.1: ‘Aticiraṃ kho bho addhamāso. Nāhaṃ sakkomi bhavante addhamāsam āgametuṃ.
dn19:55.2: Ko kho pana bho jānāti jīvitānaṃ?
dn19:55.3: Gamanīyo samparāyo, mantāya bodhabbaṃ , kattabbaṃ kusalaṃ, caritabbaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, n' atthi jātassa amaraṇaṃ.
dn19:55.4: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agārasmā ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:55.5: pabbajissām' aham bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti.
dn19:55.6: ‘Tena hi bhavaṃ Govindo sattāhaṃ āgametu yāva mayaṃ sake putta- bhātaro rajje anusāsāma. Sattāhassa accayena mayam pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti.'
dn19:55.7: ‘Na ciraṃ kho bho sattāhaṃ, āgamissām' ahaṃ bhavante sattāhan' ti. 56.
dn19:56.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo yena te satta brāhmaṇā mahā-sālā satta ca nahātaka-satāni ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā satta brāhmaṇa-mahāsāle satta ca nahātaka-satāni etad avoca:
dn19:56.2: ‘Aññaṃ dāni bhavanto ācariyaṃ pariyesantu, yo bhavantānaṃ mante vācessati.
dn19:56.3: Icchām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
dn19:56.4: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:56.5: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti.
dn19:56.7: pabbajjā bho appesakkhā ca appalābhā ca,
dn19:56.9: ‘Mā bhavanto evaṃ avacuttha: "Pabbajjā appesakkhā ca appalābhā ca, brahmaññaṃ mahesakkhañ ca mahālābhañ cāti."
dn19:56.10: Ko nu kho bho añño mayā mahesakkhataro vā mahālābhataro vā.
dn19:56.11: Ahaṃ hi bho etarahi rājā ca raññaṃ Brahmā ca brāhmaṇānaṃ devatā ca gahapatikānaṃ,
dn19:56.12: taṃ p' ahaṃ sabbaṃ pahāya agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāmi.
dn19:56.13: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:56.14: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bho agārasmā anagāriyan' ti.
dn19:56.15: ‘Sace bhavaṃ Govindo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati, mayam pi agārasmā anagariyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti.' 57.
dn19:57.1: Atha kho bho Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo yena cattārīsā bhariyā sādisiyo ten' upasaṃkami , upasaṃkamitvā cattārīsā bhariyā sādisiyo etad avoca:
dn19:57.2: ‘Yā bhoti naṃ icchati sakāni va ñāti-kulāni gacchatu, aññaṃ bhattāraṃ pariyesatu.
dn19:57.3: Icchām' ahaṃ bhoti agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajituṃ.
dn19:57.4: Yathā kho pana me sutaṃ Brahmuno āmagandhe bhāsamānassa te na sunimmadayā agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā,
dn19:57.5: pabbajissām' ahaṃ bhoti agārasmā anagāriyan' ti. ‘Tvaṃ
dn19:57.6: yeva no ñāti ñāti-kāmānaṃ. Tvaṃ pana bhattā bhattu-kāmānaṃ.
dn19:57.7: Sace bhavaṃ Govindo agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissati, mayam pi agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajissāma, atha yā te gati sā no gati bhavissatīti.' 58.
dn19:58.1: Atha kho bho Mahā Govindo brāhmaṇo tassa sattāhassa accayena kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā agārasmā anagāriyam pabbaji.
dn19:58.2: Pabbajitañ ca pana Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ satta ca rājāno khattiyā muddhāvasittā satta ca brāhmaṇa-mahāsālā satta ca nahātaka-satāni cattārīsā ca bhariyā sādisiyo anekāni ca khattiya-sahassāni anekāni ca brāhmaṇa-sahassāni anekāni ca gahapati-sahassāni anekā ca itthāgārehi itthikāyo kesa-massuṃ ohāretvā kāsāyāni vatthāni acchādetvā Mahā-Govindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajitaṃ anupabbajiṃsu.
dn19:58.3: Tāya sudaṃ bho parisāya parivuto Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo gāma-nigama-rājadhānīsu cārikaṃ carati.
dn19:58.4: Yaṃ kho pana bho tena samayena Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upasaṃkamati, tattha rājā va hoti raññaṃ Brahmā va brāhmaṇānaṃ devatā va gahapatikānaṃ.
dn19:58.5: Ye ca kho pana bho tena samayena manussā khipanti vā upakkhalanti vā,
dn19:58.7: ‘Nam' atthu MahāGovindassa brāhmaṇassa , nam' atthu satta-purohitassāti.' 59.
dn19:59.1: Mahā-Govindo bho brāhmaṇo mettā-sahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihāsi, tathā dutiyaṃ, tathā tatiyaṃ, tathā catutthaṃ. Iti uddham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ mettāsahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā vihāsi.
dn19:59.4: sahagatena cetasā ekaṃ disaṃ pharitvā vihāsi
dn19:59.5: tathā dutiyaṃ tathā tatiyaṃ tathā catutthaṃ. Iti udham adho tiriyaṃ sabbadhi sabbattatāya sabbāvantaṃ lokaṃ upekhā-sahagatena cetasā vipulena mahaggatena appamāṇena averena avyāpajjhena pharitvā vihāsi, sāvakānañ ca Brahmaloka-sahavyatāya maggaṃ desesi. 60.
dn19:60.1: Ye kho pana bho tena samayena Mahā-Govindassa brāhmaṇassa sāvakā sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājāniṃsu,
dn19:60.2: te kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā sugatiṃ Brahma-lokaṃ upapajjiṃsu.
dn19:60.3: Ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājāniṃsu, te kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā app ekacce Paranimmita-Vasavattīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjiṃsu,
dn19:60.4: app ekacce Nimmāna-ratīnaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjiṃsu,
dn19:60.5: app ekacce Tusitānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjiṃsu ,
dn19:60.6: app ekacce Yāmānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjiṃsu,
dn19:60.7: app ekacce Tāvatiṃsānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjiṃsu,
dn19:60.8: app ekacce Cātummahārājikānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyataṃ uppajjiṃsu.
dn19:60.9: Ye sabbe sabba-nihīna-kāyaṃ paripūresuṃ te gandhabba-kāyaṃ paripūresuṃ.
dn19:60.10: Iti kho bho sabbesaṃ yeva tesaṃ kula-puttānaṃ amoghā pabbajjā ahosi avañjhā saphalā sa-uddisā ti. 61.
dn19:61.2: Ahaṃ tena samayena Mahā-Govindo brāhmaṇo ahosiṃ.
dn19:61.3: Ahaṃ tesaṃ sāvakānaṃ Brahmaloka-sahavyatāya maggaṃ desesiṃ.
dn19:61.4: Taṃ kho pana Pañcasikha brahmacariyaṃ na nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāvad eva Brahmalokūpapattiyā.
dn19:61.5: Idaṃ kho pana me Pañcasikha brahmacariyaṃ ekanta-nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati,
dn19:61.8: seyyathīdaṃ sammādiṭṭhi sammā-saṃkappo sammā-vācā sammā-kammanto sammā-ājīvo sammā-vāyāmo sammā-sati sammā-samādhi.
dn19:61.9: Idaṃ kho taṃ Pañcasikha brahmacariyaṃ ekantanibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya upasamāya abhiññāya sambodhāya nibbānāya saṃvattati. 62.
dn19:62.1: ‘Ye kho pana me Pañcasikha sāvakā sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti, te āsavānaṃ khayā anāsavaṃ ceto-vimuttiṃ paññā-vimuttiṃ diṭṭhe va dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharanti.
dn19:62.2: Ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti app ekacce pañcannaṃ orambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā opapātikā honti, tattha parinibbāyino anāvatti-dhammā tasmā lokā.
dn19:62.3: Ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti app ekacce tiṇṇam saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā rāga-dosa-mohānaṃ tanuttā sakadāgāmino honti sakid eva imaṃ lokaṃ āgantvā dukkhass' antaṃ karonti.
dn19:62.4: Ye na sabbena sabbaṃ sāsanaṃ ājānanti app ekacce tiṇṇaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā sotāpannā honti avinipāta-dhammā niyatā sambodhi-parāyanā.
dn19:62.5: Iti kho Pañcasikha sabbesaṃ yeva imesaṃ kula-puttānaṃ amoghā pabbajjā avañjhā saphalā sa-uddisā' ti.
dn19:62.7: Attamano Pañcasikho Gandhabbaputto Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā tatth' ev' antaradhāyīti.
